svg.title: Attune app icon — 3d4-2r, amber on graphite
svg.desc:
THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the app icon. attune-appicon-1024.png is rendered from this, and CMake feeds that PNG to juceaide as ICON_BIG. CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS watches the PNG, so changing it re-runs configure and the icon actually rebuilds.
GRAPHITE GROUND, AMBER MARK — the Warren Labs palette, and it also settles the light/dark question for free: a dark-ground icon is correct in both appearances, which is why so many are. A light ground would have needed a separate dark variant to stop it glaring on a dark home screen.
Amber here is #EE9A3A, the DARK-GROUND amber. Do not substitute the design token --wl-accent (oklch 0.80 0.13 75 = #EEB154) or the light-ground #A8641E without re-checking contrast: on this graphite each of them is a different weight, and #A8641E on #1B1A18 is far too dim at 40pt.
One stroke, one colour, nothing colour-dependent — so the iOS tinted appearance flattens it without losing anything.
